proof_summary: For \(N=2^{t+3}\), every even number in the relevant intervals is composite, so Legendre’s formula \(v_2(m!)=m-s_2(m)\) and the binary forms of the endpoints give \(v_2(a(N))=N+t+1\) but \(v_2(a(N+1))=N-1\). Thus \(a(N)\nmid a(N+1)\) for every \(t\), and the distinct indices \(N+1\) form an infinite family of exceptions.
